description: Recursive symbolic Markov-trace computer for arbitrary H_n(q) words. Uses gb_filtration_jet_tracker.HeckeElement (symbolic in q via sympy) to expand braids into the Hecke basis, then applies recursive Markov-axiom descent for each basis element. Tested up to H_6 for representative words.
